I cleared the Punjab Police Sub Inspector exam with Rank 2 (713/800). Senior Assistant (IT) looks like an office post, but two-thirds of its paper is a computer science exam. A BCA or B.Tech CS candidate starts well ahead here.

PSSSB Advertisement No. 05 of 2023 (Group-B, 157 posts in 11 post types) was published on 23 August 2023; applications ran from 30 August to 27 September 2023, fee by 29 September 2023. This page uses that advertisement and the board's official plan of written examination for Senior Assistant (IT).

Straight answers

Frequently asked questions

What is the PSSSB Senior Assistant IT exam pattern?

Under the official Advt 05/2023 plan - 120 MCQs, 120 marks, 2 hours. Part A has 40 general questions and Part B has 80 computer science questions, with 1/4 mark cut for each wrong answer.

Which computer subjects are in the syllabus?

Computer system architecture, programming in C and C++ with OOP, database management systems, operating systems, data structures and algorithms, and data communication and computer networks.

How is it different from Senior Assistant?

The general Senior Assistant paper is 120 general questions. Senior Assistant (IT) keeps only 40 general questions and gives 80 to computer science.

When was it last advertised?

In PSSSB Advertisement No. 05 of 2023. Its eligibility, pay and post numbers are on this page.
